name: Neichu
description: A star 81 parsecs away, 8.3 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 109410: radius 8.263 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 95.476 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.037) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 109410: effective temperature 6281 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.062)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 2.85 from 2024A&A...681A.107R; the 2 published values span log g 2.854 to 3.1, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 109410: distance 80.645 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.014), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 81 parsecs away, 8.3 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 95 times the Sun's luminosity at 6,281 K, so 8.263 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 109410: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q
